our_interpretation: In context, 'such returns' means distributions from OpenAI's profits, rather than proceeds from selling an investment to another investor.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records establish realized profit distributions to the investors discussed before the post, rather than resale proceeds, valuation gains or commercial revenue-sharing payments.
